title: Two reasoning models join the text API
summary:
Two reasoning models arrived, model listings moved to the gateway, and requests got clearer model reporting and errors.

Kimi K2 Thinking and Gemini 3 Pro Preview were added with reasoning and tool support. Gemini 3 Pro Preview also accepts image, audio, and video input.

The gateway's text and image model endpoints now return registry-backed listings with aliases, pricing, descriptions, and capability metadata. The old backend `/models` endpoints return HTTP 410 and point to their replacements. The `openai` alias now selects GPT-5 Nano, while `openai-large` selects GPT-4.1.

Image responses now identify the model actually used for Turbo and Flux requests. Invalid model names and image parameters return HTTP 400; text-service errors have a structured response. Upstream IDs were corrected for three text models, Gemini's uppercase `STOP` finish reason is accepted, and streaming requests ask providers for usage data.

highlights.title: Kimi K2 Thinking
highlights.text: Use `kimi-k2-thinking` for text-based reasoning and tool use. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=kimi-k2-thinking).

highlights.title: Gemini 3 Pro Preview
highlights.text: Use `gemini-3-pro` for reasoning and tool use with text, image, audio, or video input. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gemini-3-pro).

highlights.title: Richer model listings
highlights.text: The gateway's text and image model endpoints now include aliases, pricing, descriptions, and capability metadata, making it easier to choose a model programmatically. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).
